main_text.head: HVLDRICI ZVINGLII, diuinitus missi diuinæ veritatis assertoris, Tigurini Ecclesiastæ, pro patria cæsi, pro Christi Euangelio crema- ti, Memoriæ.
main_text.l: Zvinglius arderet gemino quū sanctus amore,

l.i: Nempe Dei in primis, deinde etiam patriæ,
His iese in solidum devouerat ipse duobus,
Nempe Deo in primis, deinde etiam patriæ.
Quàm bene persoluit simul illis vota duobus,

main_text.head: MARTINI BVCERI, SVMMI in Argentinensi Ecclesia Theologi, & acerrimi diuinæ veritatis in plurimis Germaniæ comitiis assertoris, ac tandem post ipsam mortem, barbarè à barbaris, Christi odio, cremati, Memoriæ.

l.i: Quis vero & quantus fueris tua scripta loquuntur,
De vita si quis rogitet, Germania dicet

page.notes: The first verse block of the Zwingli epigram and the Bucer epigram are set in italic; the opening Z and N are large initials. Some letters in the Zwingli lines are uncertain due to scan quality (e.g. "sanctus", "patriæ"); the Bucer line "Natalés" is read with accent as printed. Greek-free page.
